description: MainActivity class for an Android wearable app demonstrating notification handling and user interaction via WearableListView.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a list of notification presets, handles user interaction, and manages reply inputs and notifications.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: An inner static class extending WearableListView.Adapter to bind notification preset data to list items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and attaches adapter and click listener to the WearableListView.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles reply input from RemoteInput if available and shows a toast message with the reply.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification based on the selected preset index.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by updating the notification according to the selected item.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty implementation for handling clicks on the empty region of the list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the list item layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the list item views based on position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notification presets available.
